items.title: Apply the script patches from the DLL (no .bat/.ps1 in the release)
items.verify: Plan tasks 1-9: research trace answered (Q1-Q6), golden test equal to ScriptPatches.ps1, owner start test and in-game check of BookMarker/Continue/PauseQuit with the DLL only, release zip without scripts, Nexus scan not quarantined.
items.evidence: Nexus quarantined 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 (VirusTotal 8/68 and 7/67, BitDefender Heur.BZC.PZQ.Boxter on the PowerShell patcher); W1's script-free zip scans 1/66. See docs/local/nexus.md. Task 1 (research) done 2026-10-31 on branch dll-script-patches: docs/fixes/dll-script-patches.md, raw excerpts in docs/validation/file-trace-2026-10-31.md. All 14 trace hooks were in place at t=+0 ms (the loader fills the original IAT before DllMain); first CookedPC access at +235 ms. Archives are found by the CookedPC\*.dzip glob and opened by absolute path; UI movies are opened loose by absolute path after a failing relative FindFirstFileExW probe, icons the same without a probe; a loose file that does not exist is never looked up by path, so new files must be entries of a redirected archive (branch B); sizes come from the find data (archives) and GetFileSize on the handle (movies and icons, twice per open); no CreateFileMappingW and no ANSI variants. Task 2 done 2026-10-31: src/sp_common.{c,h} + src/sp_dzip.{c,h} (DZIP v2 reader/writer, port of the .ps1 Dzip class) and tools/patchtest (harness built as build\sptest.exe because UAC installer detection elevates any manifest-less 32-bit exe whose name contains "patch"). All 6 tests pass, also against the owner's install: 23 archives / 31999 entries opened with the table hash verified (pack0.dzip table-only) and 612 entries of the 12 small archives decoded. Writer additions vs the reference: it patches the entry count at +8 (the .ps1 only replaces), caps an entry at 512 MB, and clamps an over-long LZF literal run (dlc_finishers.dzip has a 2-byte entry with a 16-byte literal run, which the reference's Buffer.BlockCopy would throw on). Task 3 done 2026-10-31: src/sp_swf.{c,h} (CWS->FWS through vendored tinf 1.2.1 in src/third_party/tinf, wildcard pattern search, same-length apply, SP_SWF_COMPARE) with 4 new tests. swf_real passes on 4 real movies: the HD UI originals in the old patcher backup and the abetterui.dzip copies are ORIGINAL. The four pattern arrays were checked against $SwfCompare by evaluating the .ps1 in PowerShell: 33/33/29/29 bytes identical. Task 4 done 2026-10-31: src/sp_dds.{c,h} (Decode64 for DXT1/3/5 and 32-bit, Over with .NET ties-to-even rounding, Encode64 A8R8G8B8) with 4 tests. dds_decode_dxt5 covers both DXT5 alpha branches (the real alreadyread overlay uses a0 < a1), dds_roundtrip proves decode is exact and encode writes the same file, dds_over pins 7 alpha-over cases, and dds_real_overlay decodes the real DXT5 overlay from abetterui.dzip to the reference pixels (FNV-1a64 760A865CFC2814EC from an independent Python port of the .ps1). Open point for Task 6: sp_dzip_open takes the archive in memory, but pack0.dzip is 10.5 GB and holds 1099 item icons and 63 def_*.xml, so Task 6 needs a file-backed reader; noted in the plan. Task 5 done 2026-10-31: src/scriptpatches/ holds edits.txt (the 14 $FeatureList rows) and the nine .ws fragments verbatim, plus book_texts.ws generated once by the reference New-TextFunction; src/scriptpatches.rc embeds them as RCDATA under the numeric IDs in src/sp_script_ids.h (rc turns a quoted name into part of the name, so file names cannot be resource names). src/sp_script.{c,h} ports Add-Edit/ConvertTo-Tabs/Get-CollectBody/New-ReadIconFunction with all-or-nothing per feature, a per-feature marker guard and whitespace-flexible literal anchors; build.bat and tools\patchtest\build.bat compile the .rc into the DLL and the harness. build\sptest.exe test --game: 20 tests, 0 failures; script_real applies all 14 rows to the five real 3.5.0.26 scripts (from the old patcher backup) with block counts 2/1/6/6/2, and the port output equals the reference output on those five files byte for byte (224 019 bytes, Latin-1, same book list) - a local check that Task 6's golden test makes permanent. Details in docs/fixes/dll-script-patches.md. Task 6 done 2026-10-31: src/sp_overlay.{c,h} (cache key, Get-ReadIcons, Build-Scripts, Get-PatchedSwf, Branch B archive entries, redirect table), the file-backed DZIP reader sp_dzip_file_* (pack0.dzip is 10.5 GB; new dzip_file test compares it with the in-memory path over all 23 archives), the harness build command and tools\patchtest\golden.py. GOLDEN OK: the reference on a scratch layout (old patcher backup = Project Mersey + HD UI; hard links for the other dzips) and build\sptest.exe build on an identical layout give byte-identical results - 460 base_scripts.dzip entries, 152 read-book icons (archive entries vs loose files, both directions) and ui_trade.swf/ui_storage.swf; the second build logs cache: reused and changes no file. No vanilla archive at hand: Mersey only, noted in the fix doc. Overlay build ~110 ms, cache reuse 16 ms. build\sptest.exe test --game: 22 tests, 0 failures. Task 7 Step 1 done 2026-10-31: src/sp_hooks.{c,h} (redirect table, one build per session on the first target touch under a critical section, find-data redirect), enginefix.c ([scriptpatches] keys default 1, script_dirs, scripthooks_thread installing CreateFileW/FindFirstFileW/FindNextFileW, redirect chained into hook_CreateFileW, find data into the two find hooks), build.bat now links src\sp_*.c and tinf into the DLL, [scriptpatches] documented in dist-files\witcher2_enginefix.ini. cmd /c build.bat builds; build\sptest.exe test --game 22 tests, 0 failures; golden.py still GOLDEN OK; a local hooks harness on the golden scratch layout proved the build trigger, the find size (4 508 633 = cached archive), the 3 redirects, case-insensitive matching and that unrelated paths stay untouched. Task 7 start test 1 (2026-10-31, owner, 0.5 patches uninstalled): hooks in after 0 ms (3/3), overlay built in 125 ms, both base_scripts.dzip opens served from the cache - then the game's Script compilation error, one 'parse error, near DDS' per read icon: the engine compiles every entry of base_scripts.dzip, so the icons cannot live there. items.title: Borderless window and the Display mode row in Options > Graphics
items.verify: Offline: build.bat, sptest test --game (23 tests), sptest build shows window_mode=on with the rows/handler/texts in the patched guimainmenu.ws, check_texts for the window labels, distanceprobe build-and-run (28+9+21 checks). In game: one Display mode row after Gamma in the game's language; borderless, windowed and full screen all switch at once (full screen through the engine's lost-device path); full screen -> windowed modes come back not topmost at the right size; the next start uses the last choice; 150% scaling stays 1:1; with and without DXVK.
items.evidence: docs/fixes/borderless-window.md - window creation FUN_009d44e1: windowed style 0x00C80000 at 0x009D45CA (patched to WS_POPUP through a stub), full screen at 0x009D4562/0x009D4569; [Rendering] Fullscreen lands in settings +0x10 (store 0x00B07A49) and in D3DPRESENT_PARAMETERS.Windowed, and there is no runtime mode switch; the exe's .text is encrypted until the stub's OEP jump, so the patches wait for their fingerprints; witcher2.exe has no manifest, so the DLL sets system DPI awareness early. The in-game rows are a new anchored script feature (WindowMode: 3 rows in edits.txt, ids 9201/9202) writing [Rendering] EngineFixBorderless/Fullscreen; the DLL observes the writer FUN_0041F4B7 through a trampoline hook, so borderless applies live. Offline 2026-11-02: build.bat clean, sptest 23 tests 0 failures with markers 2 1 9 6 2, overlay build window_mode=on, check_texts 12 languages ok, distanceprobe 28 native + 9 hotkey + 21 preset checks 0 failures (patch_barrier.h extraction), windowprobe 15 checks 0 failures. First in-game test 2026-11-02 (owner): the rows appeared, selecting Borderless crashed the game. Root cause in docs/validation/borderless-first-test-2026-11-02.md: FUN_0041F4B7 is __stdcall (RET 0x10) and the hook was __cdecl, so the arguments were removed twice and the hook returned into the stack (0xC0000005 at 0x001ABBD4, ebp = the wrapper's return address 0x009B50EF). Fixed: __stdcall hook plus the shared trampoline helper and windowprobe; the style-patch install now retries for 3 s because the peer-stop barrier was refused during startup thread churn. Second build 2026-11-02 (owner): borderless off/on filled the screen every time once the restyle used [Viewport] Width/Height instead of the clamped client area. The owner then asked for live full screen, one grouped control and no hotkey. Third build: the viewport tick (vtable slot 0x00EC60F8 -> FUN_009E146E) is hooked and drives the engine's lost-device state machine at viewport +0xB0 (1 release, 3 Reset) with a new Windowed flag in the stored present parameters (0x016267A0 + 0x20); the two rows became one Display mode selector (ui_mainmenu.swf uses one row pitch for all row types, so on/off rows read as uneven gaps); Ctrl+F11 removed. Offline: build clean, sptest 0 failures (markers 2 1 10 6 2), check_texts ok, windowprobe 15/15, distanceprobe 0 failures. Third build in game (owner, DXVK + NVIDIA, full screen start): full screen -> borderless -> windowed worked, -> full screen again crashed: stack overflow in a window-procedure loop between DXVK's D3D9WindowProc and NVIDIA's wglWndProc (WER dump, offline cdb; DXVK only restores its original procedure when it is still on top). Fourth build: the game's class procedure 0x009D237E is put back before every Reset and after a Reset into windowed (wrapper d3d9 only); the success OSD lines were removed (the menu row shows the choice). Fourth build in game (owner, 2026-11-02): every Display mode switch works with DXVK, and again with DXVK disabled (bin\d3d9.dll renamed, Windows d3d9). Known cosmetic limit: switching with the menu open over a level shows characters in bind pose until the menu closes (paused animation after the device reset).
